system.kernel.disable-exception-chain-va.anticheat_details: Disabling SEH chain validation changes a kernel-observed exploit mitigation and may be interpreted as hostile tampering by anti-cheat integrity checks.

policy.system.enable-virtualization.anticheat_details: Changing virtualization and VBS posture can affect kernel integrity surfaces and compatibility with some anti-cheat stacks.

security.disable-system-mitigations.anticheat_details: Exploit-protection and mitigation policy changes can alter process mitigation posture that anti-cheat or DRM integrity checks may inspect.

security.disable-vbs.anticheat_details: VBS and Device Guard posture changes affect kernel integrity and virtualization-backed security surfaces that anti-cheat and DRM stacks commonly validate.

system.kernel-thread-dpc-enable.anticheat_details: Threaded-DPC policy is a kernel scheduling surface; compatibility with kernel-sensitive anti-cheat and DRM stacks should be reviewed before gaming use.

system.kernel.force-bugcheck-for-dpc-wat.anticheat_details: DPC watchdog bugcheck behavior is a safety-sensitive kernel diagnostic surface and should be treated as anti-cheat/DRM review-required.

system.kernel-dpc-watchdog-control-clust.anticheat_details: DPC watchdog control thresholds are privileged kernel timing/watchdog surfaces; anti-cheat and DRM compatibility requires explicit review.

system.kernel-dpc-watchdog-profile-clust.anticheat_details: DPC watchdog profiling thresholds influence kernel watchdog/profile behavior and should be reviewed before use on anti-cheat or DRM-protected systems.

system.kernel-long-dpc-threshold-cluster.anticheat_details: Long-DPC threshold tuning changes kernel latency/diagnostic behavior; anti-cheat and DRM compatibility should be reviewed explicitly.

system.kernel.timer-check-flags.anticheat_details: Timer-check flags are kernel timer validation surfaces; review is required before applying near anti-cheat or DRM workloads.

system.kernel.global-timer-resolution-re.anticheat_details: Global timer-resolution request policy can affect kernel timing behavior observed by latency-sensitive anti-cheat or DRM systems.

system.kernel-dpc-watchdog-period.anticheat_details: DPC watchdog period tuning conflicts with observed current-build watchdog state and should remain anti-cheat/DRM review-required.

power.disable-power-throttling.anticheat_details: This is primarily a power-management change and is not expected to modify exploit mitigations or kernel integrity state.
